protocol.environment: Flat ground, MuJoCo, ZenbotPlayer with release defaults. Seeds other than 42 use independent joint-angle and roll/pitch jitter within ±2°, horizontal initial root velocity jitter within ±0.07 m/s per axis. Five actuator groups draw delays of 3–7 physics steps for each seed and trial.
protocol.first_attempt: Pre-rise pelvis-height retry count zero, reached stand, no measured refall, passed final 2 s posture/load/speed check.
protocol.postrise: Maximum horizontal distance of the pelvis, or either foot from its own first-standing position. Standing begins with 10 consecutive 50 Hz samples of pelvis height in (0.58, 0.78] m, root tilt <30 degrees.
protocol.last_10s_quiet: In at least 90% of samples: each foot bears >=10% of bodyweight, pelvis horizontal speed <0.08 m/s, and both foot horizontal speeds <0.05 m/s.
protocol.pelvis_max_from_t10_cm: Maximum horizontal excursion from pelvis position at t=10 s through t=60 s.
protocol.feet_max_from_t10_cm: Maximum horizontal excursion of either foot from its own position at t=10 s through t=60 s.
